afterCycles.diagnosis: Chromium launches successfully in this session — a later control run got as far as page.goto — but the page/context closes during the chat-cycle phase every time (four attempts, 6/4/3/3 cycles, the last with the dev server confirmed answering HTTP 200). One earlier control run hit ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED because the server itself had been lost to a runner restart, so both failure modes exist in this session and neither is an application defect. The after-cycles attribution is therefore not captured and no growth/leak classification is claimed.
afterCycles.conclusion: window saturates at 63 listeners / 57 distinct sites after the first cycle and does not grow on cycles 2 and 3 (63/57/6 twice, then 63/57/6 again); document stays at 3/3 with no duplicates. Every duplicate group is exactly 2 registrations and is identical across cycles (supabase-js pagehide/pageshow/visibilitychange, react-three-fiber scroll/resize), so nothing re-registers per cycle at window or document scope. The residual growth is DOM-wide: JSEventListeners total 1949 -> 8629 on first mount, then +170/+174 per cycle while Nodes move 1005 -> 1012 -> 1019 (+7/cycle). That is a document-wide total, not attribution, and this gate forbids presenting it as such, so it is recorded as UNATTRIBUTED residual rather than a leak.
afterCycles.priorFailure: the four earlier attempts used the 5.7 script whose click/waits lacked per-cycle checkpoints; the rewritten probe samples and persists after every cycle and completed 3/3 cycles, so the earlier 'context closed' outcome was harness flow, not a browser that cannot run here.

classification: growth cannot be classified as expected / retained / unbounded without the after-cycles capture. No leak claim is made.
